Playlist Mode — Ordered Task Sequences with Prompt Injections
description:
Add --playlist FILE mode to ralph for executing an explicit sequence of bead tasks
interleaved with raw Claude prompts. This enables orchestrated multi-epic execution
with intermediate cleanup, review, and plan-adjustment steps.

MOTIVATION:
Ralph currently picks tasks reactively from br ready. For large planned work (e.g.,
39 tasks across 6 Flutter epics), we need:
1. Explicit execution order (not just dependency-graph order)
2. Intermediate non-bead prompts between tasks (review, fix, adjust beads)
3. Resumable execution (crash-safe via playlist line tracking)

PLAYLIST FORMAT:
Each line is one of:
* Bead ID (e.g., chippie-ogz3.1) — executed as normal bead task
* > Raw prompt text — executed as free-form Claude prompt (no bead)
* # Comment — skipped
* Blank line — skipped

DESIGN PRINCIPLES:
* Minimal changes to existing code (ralph is 1,430 lines — keep it simple)
* Playlist mode is an alternative to br-ready mode, not a replacement
* --playlist and --scope are mutually exclusive
* All existing features (circuit breaker, monitoring, tmux, remote) still work
* Playlist state (current line) persisted in .ralph_state for crash recovery

6 child tasks covering: config/args, playlist reader, raw prompt builder,
main loop integration, state tracking/resume, dry-run validation.

title: Playlist reader — parse file, track position, classify lines
description:
Create lib/playlist.sh with functions to read and navigate the playlist file.

FUNCTIONS TO IMPLEMENT:

playlist_init()
* Read playlist file into memory (array or line-by-line)
* Set playlist_total (total actionable lines, excluding comments/blanks)
* Initialize playlist_line from .ralph_state (for resume) or 0

playlist_next()
* Return next unprocessed line (advancing past comments/blanks)
* Set globals: playlist_current_line (text), playlist_line_type ("bead" or "prompt")
* Return 1 when playlist exhausted

playlist_line_type detection:
* Lines starting with ">" (after trim) → type "prompt", strip the ">" prefix
* Lines starting with "#" → skip (comment)
* Blank lines → skip
* Everything else → type "bead" (treat as bead ID)

FILES TO CREATE:

FILES TO MODIFY:
* lib/loader.sh — add playlist.sh to load order (after tasks.sh)

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
* Correctly parses sample playlist with mixed beads, prompts, comments, blanks
* Tracks position for resume
* playlist_next returns 1 at end of file

title: Raw prompt builder — wrap > lines with project context
description:
Add build_raw_prompt() to prompt.sh for non-bead prompt lines.

When a playlist line is a > prompt, it needs project context wrapping so Claude
knows where it is and what rules to follow.

FUNCTION: build_raw_prompt(prompt_text)
Sets global $prompt to:

"""
You are performing a maintenance task between automated bead implementations
in the ralph autonomous loop.

## Task
<prompt_text>

## Context
* Working directory: $(pwd)
* Branch: $(git branch --show-current)
* Recent commits: $(git log --oneline -5)

## Rules
1. Search the codebase before assuming anything about structure.
2. Make targeted fixes and commit with conventional commit messages.
3. You may update beads using br update/br create/br close as needed.
4. Do NOT touch .beads/ files directly — use br commands only.
5. Do NOT run br sync — the outer loop handles that.
6. When done, just exit. There is no bead to close for this task.
"""

FILES TO MODIFY:
* lib/prompt.sh — add build_raw_prompt() function

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
* Raw prompt includes project context (pwd, branch, recent commits)
* Claude receives clear rules for non-bead maintenance work
* No bead-closing instructions (since there's no bead)

title: Main loop integration — playlist mode branch in while-loop
description:
Modify the main ralph loop to support playlist mode alongside existing br-ready mode.

CHANGES TO MAIN LOOP (ralph script):
When PLAYLIST is set, replace select_task with playlist_next.
Two code paths based on playlist_line_type:

"bead" path (existing flow):
  tid=$playlist_current_line
  claim_task, build_prompt, invoke_claude, check_bead_status,
  update_circuit_breaker, handle_task_outcome — all unchanged

"prompt" path (new):
  build_raw_prompt "$playlist_current_line"
  invoke_claude (no bead status check after)
  log completion, advance playlist position
  circuit breaker: treat as "progress" (always resets no-progress count)

Exit conditions addition:
* Playlist exhausted → EXIT_REASON="Playlist complete"

IMPORTANT: The existing br-ready mode must be completely unaffected.
When PLAYLIST is empty, the loop works exactly as before.

FILES TO MODIFY:
* ralph (main script) — add playlist branch in while-loop
* lib/circuit_breaker.sh — no changes needed (prompt tasks always count as progress)

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
* ralph --playlist test.txt executes bead lines as bead tasks
* ralph --playlist test.txt executes > lines as raw prompts
* ralph (no --playlist) works exactly as before
* Playlist exhaustion triggers clean exit with summary
* Circuit breaker works correctly for bead tasks in playlist
* Raw prompt tasks always count as "progress" (no false circuit trips)

title: Playlist state persistence — resume after crash/interrupt
description:
Persist playlist position in .ralph_state for crash recovery.

CHANGES:

save_state() in lib/utils.sh:
* When PLAYLIST is set, also write:
  playlist_file=<filename>
  playlist_line=<current line number>

load_state() in lib/utils.sh:
* When PLAYLIST is set, read playlist_line from state file
* If playlist_file in state doesn't match current --playlist arg, warn and reset to 0
* Pass playlist_line to playlist_init() for resume

Monitoring (lib/monitor.sh):
* When playlist mode active, show:
  Playlist: <filename> [line X/Y]
  Current: <bead ID or "prompt injection">

FILES TO MODIFY:
* lib/utils.sh — save_state(), load_state()
* lib/monitor.sh — render_dashboard() add playlist display

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
* Kill ralph mid-playlist, restart → resumes from correct line
* --reset clears playlist position
* Monitor shows playlist progress
* State file round-trips correctly

title: Playlist dry-run validation — check IDs, deps, print plan
description:
ralph --playlist FILE --dry-run should validate and display the full execution plan.

BEHAVIOR:
1. Parse entire playlist file
2. For each bead ID line:
   * Validate ID exists (br show)
   * Check status (warn if already closed)
   * Check if dependencies are satisfied by prior playlist lines
   * (warn only, don't error — user may have handled deps externally)
3. For each > prompt line:
   * Display the prompt text (truncated to 80 chars)
4. Print summary: X bead tasks, Y prompt injections, estimated time

OUTPUT FORMAT:
  PLAYLIST: flutter.playlist (35 items: 28 beads + 7 prompts)

  1. [bead]   chippie-ogz3.1 — Environment Configuration (ready)
  2. [bead]   chippie-ogz3.3 — Create Typed DTOs (ready)
  3. [prompt] Run flutter pub run build_runner build and fix any codeg...
  4. [bead]   chippie-ogz3.2 — Fix Authentication Flow (blocked by ogz3.1)
  ...
  WARNINGS:
  * Line 4: chippie-ogz3.2 is blocked by chippie-ogz3.1 — ensure line 1 completes first

FILES TO MODIFY:
* lib/tasks.sh — add playlist_dry_run() or modify handle_dry_run()

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA:
* All bead IDs validated against br
* Dependency ordering warnings shown
* Already-closed beads flagged
* Clean summary printed
* Exit 0 on success

title: Ralph MVP — Single Bash Script
description: Create /Users/admin/dev/ralph/ralph — a single bash file (~250 lines) that autonomously executes beads issues by looping Claude Code invocations. Deterministic outer loop; all intelligence in Claude Code inner loop. Source: ~/.claude/plans/wiggly-honking-gem.md

title: Script foundation: header, config, utilities, arg parsing, prereqs, early-exit
description: Create ralph script with sections 1-6: shebang + strict mode, default configuration (MAX_TASKS, MAX_LOOPS, TIMEOUT_MINUTES, SCOPE, STATE_FILE), utility functions (log, load_state, save_state), argument parsing (--dry-run, --max-tasks, --max-loops, --timeout, --scope, --status, --reset, --help), prerequisite checks (jq, bd, claude, gtimeout/timeout, .beads/), and early-exit handlers (--status prints state, --reset clears state). ~90 lines.

title: Task selection: pick_next_task and get_task_details functions
description: Implement pick_next_task() — runs bd ready --json --limit 20, uses jq to skip epics (issue_type != epic), applies --scope pattern via jq test(), returns first match ID. Implement get_task_details() — runs bd show ID --json, extracts .issue.title, .issue.description, .issue.notes, .issue.acceptance_criteria, .issue.design with jq. ~35 lines.

title: Main loop: Claude invocation, response parsing, circuit breaker, task outcomes
description: Implement the core outer loop: exit condition checks (max_tasks, max_loops, circuit OPEN), task picking with current_task retry for EXIT_SIGNAL=false, claim via bd update --status in_progress, prompt construction from template + task details, Claude invocation with timeout (claude -p PROMPT --output-format json --max-turns 50 --verbose), response parsing (extract .result with jq, extract RALPH_STATUS block, parse STATUS/FILES_MODIFIED/EXIT_SIGNAL/SUMMARY), circuit breaker state machine (CLOSED->HALF_OPEN at no_progress>=2, HALF_OPEN->OPEN at no_progress>=3, recovery on progress), and task outcome handling (COMPLETE: bd close + bd set-state verified=needs-review, BLOCKED: release claim, EXIT_SIGNAL false: retry same task). ~100 lines.

title: Exit summary and cleanup trap
